  <!-- CHAPTER 1: PROBLEM INVESTIGATION -->
  <div class="page-break">
    <div style="background: #0b1a2e; color: #fff; padding: 6px 14px; font-family: Arial; font-size: 10pt; font-weight: bold; margin-bottom: 15px;">
      CHAPTER 1: PROBLEM INVESTIGATION
    </div>

    <h2>1.1 Introduction</h2>
    <p>
      In the modern architectural and spatial design domain, having a high-performance, visually compelling, and dynamic digital portfolio is foundational for communicating design sensibilities, spatial balance, and structural accomplishments to prospective clients. Architecture firms, interior design studios, and urban planners depend heavily on visual media to present floor plans, 3D renderings, and completed elevations.
    </p>
    <p>
      However, conventional architectural websites suffer from a severe dual bottleneck: they are either built as rigid, static HTML brochure websites requiring manual code alterations whenever a new project is completed, or they rely on monolithic, slow Content Management Systems (CMS) with significant database overhead, security maintenance burdens, and recurring hosting expenses.
    </p>
    <p>
      The <strong>Urban Design Studio</strong> project is engineered as a robust, academic-grade <strong>3-Tier Full-Stack Web Application</strong>. It combines an architectural editorial user interface with an asynchronous <strong>Node.js and Express.js REST API</strong> backend, <strong>Google Firebase Realtime Database</strong> for dynamic content retrieval and persistence, and <strong>ImgBB Cloud Media API</strong> with client-side Canvas processing as a fallback for image hosting. A dedicated <strong>Admin Control Panel</strong> (`/admin.html`) enables studio managers to perform live CRUD operations without code editing.
    </p>

    <h3>1.1.1 Existing Situation</h3>
    <p>Prior to designing this platform, small-to-midscale architectural practices faced four primary operational constraints:</p>
    <ol>
      <li><strong>Static Hardcoding Bottleneck:</strong> Portfolios and team biographies are hardcoded into static HTML templates. Adding a new residence or updating staff requires developer intervention and full site redeployment.</li>
      <li><strong>Unoptimized High-Resolution Media:</strong> Architectural elevations and photographs often exceed 5â€“10 MB. Direct uncompressed uploads lead to server timeouts and degraded mobile page loads.</li>
      <li><strong>Monolithic CMS Overhead:</strong> Conventional platforms like WordPress require PHP runtime engines, SQL databases, recurring hosting costs, and frequent security updates.</li>
      <li><strong>Disconnected Inquiries:</strong> Contact buttons typically rely on passive <code>mailto:</code> links without persistent database tracking or status verification.</li>
    </ol>

    <h3>1.1.2 Proposed System</h3>
    <p>
      The proposed system is an integrated 3-tier architecture with dynamic data streaming. Architectural designs and team profiles are loaded asynchronously via REST APIs, uploaded imagery is sent to the backend for ImgBB hosting, with an optimized Canvas data URL used when the external upload fails; client inquiries are stored through the REST API, and studio managers receive CRUD controls through the admin portal.
    </p>

    <div style="page-break-before: always;"></div>
    <h2>1.2 Goal, Objectives & Scope of the Project</h2>
    <p><strong>Primary Goal:</strong> To engineer and deploy an academic-grade, responsive 3-tier full-stack architecture portfolio and studio management platform using Node.js, Express.js, Firebase Realtime Database, and ImgBB Cloud API that empowers architectural firms to showcase designs, manage staff profiles, and capture client inquiries with zero hosting expenses.</p>
    
    <p><strong>Concrete Engineering Objectives:</strong></p>
    <ul>
      <li><strong>3-Tier Decoupled Architecture:</strong> Decouple Presentation Layer (HTML5/CSS3/JS), Application Layer (Express REST API), and Cloud Persistence Layer (Firebase RTDB).</li>
      <li><strong>Dynamic Portfolio Management:</strong> Enable asynchronous retrieval (`GET`) and creation (`POST`) of architecture projects and team profiles.</li>
      <li><strong>Media Optimization Pipeline:</strong> Combine in-browser Canvas compression with ImgBB API to eliminate upload timeouts.</li>
      <li><strong>Direct Lead Capture:</strong> Record prospective client inquiries with timestamps and provide administrative deletion.</li>
      <li><strong>Mobile-First Responsiveness:</strong> Deliver fluid layouts across 360px smartphones, tablets, and 4K desktop viewports.</li>
      <li><strong>Zero-Cost Production Deployment:</strong> Use the Vercel-compatible serverless entry point and deployment configuration supplied with the project.</li>
    </ul>

    <p><strong>Scope of the Project:</strong></p>
    <ul>
      <li><em>Included:</em> Dynamic project cards, Lightbox modal preview, architect bios, client inquiry submission, admin portal (`/admin.html`) with project/architect/inquiry CRUD, canvas image compression, ImgBB upload, Firebase RTDB persistence.</li>
      <li><em>Excluded:</em> Multi-tenant multi-studio registration, integrated payment gateways for blueprints, and 3D WebGL CAD file rendering.</li>
    </ul>
  </div>

    <h2>2.1 Information Gathering, Needs & Constraints</h2>
    <p>System analysis involved surveying design requirements for modern creative studios, focusing on high visual fidelity, minimal interface clutter, and low-latency data updates.</p>

    <table>
      <thead>
        <tr><th>Stakeholder Need</th><th>How Urban Design Studio Meets It</th></tr>
      </thead>
      <tbody>
        <tr><td><strong>Dynamic Portfolio Management</strong></td><td>Projects and architect profiles load asynchronously from Firebase Realtime Database via REST endpoints.</td></tr>
        <tr><td><strong>Fast Image Uploads & Display</strong></td><td>The browser prepares an optimized fallback data URL; the normal path uploads the selected file through the Express endpoint to ImgBB.</td></tr>
        <tr><td><strong>Interactive Visual Inspection</strong></td><td>Integrated JavaScript Lightbox modal enables full-screen image inspection without triggering page reloads.</td></tr>
        <tr><td><strong>Dedicated Admin Controls</strong></td><td>Studio staff can add/remove projects, add/remove architects, and inspect/delete client inquiries via a dedicated `/admin.html` dashboard.</td></tr>
        <tr><td><strong>Cross-Device Responsiveness</strong></td><td>Built using modern CSS Grid, Flexbox, and media queries, providing fluid layouts from 360px smartphones to 4K displays.</td></tr>
        <tr><td><strong>Secure Key Handling</strong></td><td>Third-party API keys (ImgBB) and Firebase database URLs reside in backend environment variables (`.env`), shielded from client inspection.</td></tr>
      </tbody>
    </table>

    <div style="page-break-before: always;"></div>

    <h2>2.4 Hardware and Software Requirements</h2>
    <table>
      <thead>
        <tr><th>Layer</th><th>Hardware & Software Specification</th></tr>
      </thead>
      <tbody>
        <tr><td><strong>Client Hardware</strong></td><td>Standard desktop/laptop/smartphone, Dual-Core CPU, 2 GB+ RAM, modern web browser, active internet.</td></tr>
        <tr><td><strong>Server Infrastructure</strong></td><td>Vercel Edge Serverless Cloud Platform (Auto-scaling Node.js runtime, 1024 MB RAM limit).</td></tr>
        <tr><td><strong>Operating System</strong></td><td>Windows 11 (Development) / Linux Container (Vercel Serverless Production).</td></tr>
        <tr><td><strong>Frontend Technologies</strong></td><td>Semantic HTML5, CSS3 (Variables, Flexbox, Grid), Vanilla JavaScript (ES6+), HTML5 Canvas API.</td></tr>
        <tr><td><strong>Backend Framework</strong></td><td>Node.js runtime, Express.js RESTful API Framework.</td></tr>
        <tr><td><strong>Database & Storage</strong></td><td>Firebase Realtime Database accessed through REST, with local JSON fallback.</td></tr>
        <tr><td><strong>Media Hosting API</strong></td><td>ImgBB Cloud API v1.</td></tr>
        <tr><td><strong>Version Control</strong></td><td>Git, GitHub (`Me-shailesh-003/urban-design-studio`), Visual Studio Code.</td></tr>
      </tbody>
    </table>

  <!-- CHAPTER 4: TOOLS & ARCHITECTURE USED -->
  <div class="page-break">
    <div style="background: #0b1a2e; color: #fff; padding: 6px 14px; font-family: Arial; font-size: 10pt; font-weight: bold; margin-bottom: 15px;">
      CHAPTER 4: TOOLS & ARCHITECTURE USED

    <h2>4.1 3-Tier System Architecture & Front-End Stack</h2>
    <p>
      The architecture of <strong>Urban Design Studio</strong> adheres to a strict 3-tier model, ensuring high modularity, independent scalability, and security:
    </p>

    <div class="diagram-box">
+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
|                      PRESENTATION LAYER (Client Browser)                              |
|  - index.html (Client Portfolio)       - admin.html (Studio Control Panel)            |
|  - styles.css (Responsive Architecture Design)  - script.js & admin.js (Fetch & UI)   |
|  - HTML5 Canvas API (Client-Side Image Compression & Optimization)                    |
+------------------------------------------+--------------------------------------------+
                                           | HTTPS Asynchronous REST (JSON / Multipart)
                                           v
+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
|                      APPLICATION LAYER (Node.js & Express API Server)                 |
|  - server.js / api/index.js (Serverless Router & Gateway on Vercel)                   |
|  - Multer (Multipart Form Stream Handler)  - CORS & Dotenv (Environment Security)     |
|  - Express Body Parser (Expanded 50 MB Payload Support)                               |
+------------------------------------------+--------------------------------------------+
                                           | JSON REST & Media API Requests
                                           v
+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
|                      DATA PERSISTENCE & STORAGE LAYER (Cloud Services)                |
|  - Google Firebase Realtime Database (Live NoSQL Document Store)                      |
|  - ImgBB Cloud API (CDN Media Storage for Architectural Renderings)                   |
|  - Local JSON Fallback (data.json for Offline Resilience)                             |
+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
    </div>

    <table>
      <thead>
        <tr><th>Layer</th><th>Technology</th><th>Engineering Role & Capability</th></tr>
      </thead>
      <tbody>
        <tr><td rowspan="4"><strong>Presentation<br>Layer</strong></td><td>HTML5</td><td>Semantic layout elements (`header`, `nav`, `section`, `article`, `footer`, forms).</td></tr>
        <tr><td>CSS3</td><td>CSS custom properties, Flexbox layout, CSS Grid, media queries for 360px+ screens.</td></tr>
        <tr><td>Vanilla JS (ES6+)</td><td>Asynchronous Fetch API, DOM manipulation, Lightbox viewer, mobile navigation.</td></tr>
        <tr><td>Canvas API</td><td>In-browser image optimization: scales and compresses images to ~50 KB before dispatch.</td></tr>
        <tr><td rowspan="3"><strong>Application<br>Layer</strong></td><td>Node.js runtime</td><td>Event-driven non-blocking runtime executing serverless API functions.</td></tr>
        <tr><td>Express.js</td><td>RESTful routing controllers, CORS middleware, 50 MB JSON payload handling.</td></tr>
        <tr><td>Multer</td><td>In-memory stream buffer processing multipart image uploads for ImgBB dispatch.</td></tr>
        <tr><td rowspan="2"><strong>Data & Cloud<br>Layer</strong></td><td>Firebase RTDB</td><td>Cloud NoSQL database synchronizing projects, architects, and inquiries via REST.</td></tr>
        <tr><td>ImgBB API</td><td>Cloud media CDN hosting project elevations and architect photography.</td></tr>
      </tbody>
    </table>
  </div>

  <!-- CHAPTER 7: CONCLUSION & FUTURE SCOPE -->
  <div class="page-break">
    <div style="background: #0b1a2e; color: #fff; padding: 6px 14px; font-family: Arial; font-size: 10pt; font-weight: bold; margin-bottom: 15px;">
      CHAPTER 7: CONCLUSION & FUTURE SCOPE
    </div>

    <h2>7.1 Salient Features of the System</h2>
    <ol>
      <li><strong>3-Tier Full-Stack Decoupling:</strong> Strict separation of presentation, Express REST APIs, and Firebase NoSQL document persistence.</li>
      <li><strong>Dynamic REST-backed content:</strong> Projects, architects, and inquiries are loaded and changed through Express routes backed by Firebase or local JSON.</li>
      <li><strong>Fallback media optimization:</strong> Canvas creates a reduced JPEG data URL when ImgBB upload is unavailable; successful ImgBB uploads use the original file buffer.</li>
      <li><strong>Complete Admin CRUD Autonomy:</strong> Dedicated `/admin.html` dashboard provides full control over content without code modifications.</li>
      <li><strong>Mobile-First Responsive Engineering:</strong> Fluid layouts across 360px smartphones, tablets, and 4K desktops with touch-friendly controls.</li>
      <li><strong>Vercel-compatible deployment:</strong> `vercel.json` routes `/api/*` requests to `api/index.js`; hosting cost and CI/CD status depend on the deployment environment.</li>
    </ol>

    <h2>7.2 Limitations of the System</h2>
    <ul>
      <li><strong>No Authentication:</strong> The admin page is reachable at `/admin.html`; role-based login and authorization are not implemented.</li>
      <li><strong>Third-Party CDN Dependency:</strong> Image delivery relies on external ImgBB availability when local canvas fallback is inactive.</li>
      <li><strong>Single Studio Scope:</strong> Schema is tailored to a single studio rather than multi-tenant architectural agency workspaces.</li>
    </ul>

    <div style="page-break-before: always;"></div>
    <h2>7.3 Scope of Future Enhancements</h2>
    <ul>
      <li><strong>Role-Based Authentication (RBAC):</strong> Integrate Firebase Authentication (Email/Password & Google OAuth) with JWT tokens.</li>
      <li><strong>Interactive 3D BIM / CAD Viewer:</strong> Embed Three.js / WebGL viewers allowing clients to inspect 3D architectural models in-browser.</li>
      <li><strong>Client Site Progress Tracker:</strong> Private client dashboard to track construction milestones, drawings, and site photography.</li>
      <li><strong>Automated Email Notifications:</strong> Integrate Nodemailer / SendGrid APIs for instant email confirmations upon inquiry submission.</li>
    </ul>
  </div>
